svg.title: What a standards-compliant trace records by default, and what you have to switch on
svg.desc: Two panels side by side. The left panel lists the OpenTelemetry GenAI attributes an instrumentation is told to record by default: operation name, model, input and output token totals, finish reasons, conversation identifier, compaction flag, tool name, tool call identifier, duration and error type. The right panel, highlighted, lists what is either marked Opt-In in the standard or has no attribute at all: the tool call arguments, the tool call result, tool-result tokens per result, the number of tool results in one reply, the pass index, and the retrieved document identifiers. A footer states that the dividing line is whether the field can carry the customer's data, not whether it matters.
